sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-Optimized-Speed is a 4-bit quantized version of Qwen 3.8 27B optimized for Apple Silicon Macs, built and maintained by Youssofal. The model retains the original multi-token-prediction (MTP) head, enabling MTPLX's speculative decoding to draft multiple tokens ahead and verify them in a single pass, delivering 2-3x speedup compared to standard inference.
